content: CEF stable 156.0.8 (Chromium 156.0.8078.48); minimal distributions 128 MB macOS arm64 and 166 MB Windows x64 compressed. cef crate 156.1.0+156.0.8 under tauri-apps/cef-rs, ~314k downloads, 0.x API. CefRequestContext::LoadExtension deprecated since CEF 130 (2025); Chrome 137 removed --load-extension, so extension loading strategy is in transition. Castlabs provides Widevine/VMP for Electron and custom Chromium, not confirmed for CEF.
